name: Payment Obligation 2
definition: Payment obligation contracted between two financial institutions related to the financing of a commercial transaction.

ObligorBank.name: Obligor Bank
ObligorBank.definition: Bank that has to pay under the obligation.

RecipientBank.name: Recipient Bank
RecipientBank.definition: Bank that will be paid under the obligation.

PaymentObligationAmount.name: Payment Obligation Amount
PaymentObligationAmount.definition: Payment obligation amount specified as an amount or percentage.

Charges.name: Charges
Charges.definition: Charges related to the payment obligation.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Date at which the obligation will expire.

ApplicableRules.name: Applicable Rules
ApplicableRules.definition: Rules which apply to the BPO (Bank Payment Obligation).

ApplicableLaw.name: Applicable Law
ApplicableLaw.definition: Country of which the law governs the bank payment obligation.

PlaceOfJurisdiction.name: Place Of Jurisdiction
PlaceOfJurisdiction.definition: Location and forum for dispute resolution.

PaymentTerms.name: Payment Terms
PaymentTerms.definition: Payment processes required to transfer cash from the debtor to the creditor.

SettlementTerms.name: Settlement Terms
SettlementTerms.definition: Instruction between two clearing agents stipulating the cash transfer characteristics between the two parties.
